title: Closing
intro: Closing is the end-of-day cash and payment reconciliation screen. Count terminal cash, record expenses, review payment totals, then save a draft or complete the closing cycle.

sections.title: Closing overview
steps: The title shows today’s date and the active closing window (business day cycle).
Alerts warn if the cycle is disabled or already completed.
sections.caption: Closing screen header and cycle window.

sections.title: Balances and terminal cash
steps: Enter previous day balance and petty cash added today.
For each terminal, count notes and coins or enter a total cash amount.
Add or remove terminals with the Add terminal control.
sections.caption: Terminal cash counting section.

sections.title: Payments and expenses
steps: Payment summary lists each payment type with system totals (editable when not completed).
Add expenses with description, category, and amount.
Net amount summarizes cash, other payments, expenses, and balances.
sections.caption: Payment summaries and expenses.

sections.title: Save, complete, and print
steps: Save closing stores a draft without locking the day.
Close closing completes the cycle (open orders in the cycle must be settled first).
Print closing sends a summary slip to the printer.
Reopen appears after completion if your role can edit closings.
sections.caption: Save, close, print, and reopen actions.
